blockers.topic: Live reference access and fresh numeric evidence
blockers.evidence_needed: Permitted interactive browser or retained actual calculation responses, with exact inputs, model, units, date and all printed outputs.
blockers.impact: All direct reference acceptance stays open. Independent engine and documented-field work can continue.

blockers.evidence_needed: Open every saturation selector for both models; retain option values/labels, phase or branch controls and examples. Resolve the help's unenumerated count of 15.
blockers.impact: P/T with quality contract is known. Remaining selector functions must not be invented from that count.

blockers.topic: Registered controls and full field availability
blockers.evidence_needed: Authorized registered session where required; property availability, turbine mode-dependent fields/steam restrictions, vapor h-s bounds/backgrounds and downloaded files.
blockers.impact: Public indexed labels are inventoried; hidden or disabled variants and numerical results remain unconfirmed.

blockers.topic: Gas frozen-composition model data and conventions
blockers.evidence_needed: BSW2003 equations/coefficients with usable provenance, mass versus mole percentage basis, molar masses/gas constant, h/s zeros and mixture entropy convention; pure and mixed reference cases.
blockers.impact: NASA7 must remain a distinct reproducible model. Equal component names cannot establish numerical equivalence.

blockers.evidence_needed: Actual dissociation model, coefficients, definition of Dissociation output and component percentages, lambda input or inference, cp/cv derivatives and pressure restrictions. Cases below/at/above 2000 K and lambda=1.05, off/on comparisons.
blockers.impact: Documented upper T=2000 K and lambda>1.05 narrow scope; a general equilibrium solver would not by itself match the reference.

blockers.evidence_needed: Website numerical cases at claimed extended limits and each property's valid boundary; identify correlation versions and explicit extrapolation behavior.
blockers.impact: Do not raise p/T guards solely to match a help claim; independently demonstrated local scientific-domain gaps are tracked for P05.

blockers.evidence_needed: Reference formula and fixed/default pressure convention; at least two ambient temperatures and matched reference states, SI/English.
blockers.impact: Reference help documents ambient temperature only; local P0/T0 control does not prove the same exergy zero.

blockers.evidence_needed: Real CSV/Unicode CSV, Excel 97–2003 XLS, XLSX and OpenDocument downloads for state/saturation/process/gas; inspect encoding, signatures, worksheets and nulls with independent readers.
blockers.impact: Format families are specified; exact byte variants and exported result coverage are unverified.

blockers.evidence_needed: Reference axis limits/background families for all three views, labels/IDs, line/spline control behavior, SI/English, editing and image/print output.
blockers.impact: Documented controls have a contract; numerical coordinates and interpolation behavior require direct examples.
